purpose: Independent same-pinned-state balance measurement of three captured successful Hyperlend simulations

warnings: Balances are measured before and after an ephemeral state diff at the same pinned block hash and timestamp.
USDC cash, hUSDC supplied positions and non-transferable USDC debt are reported separately. Reserve custody balances are not user wealth.
This measurement covers only the involved accounts and these three configured tokens; it does not assess transaction security or predict future blocks.

limitations: Each operation is an independent unsigned simulation at the same block, not a transaction sequence.
No transaction was signed or broadcast.
Three cases do not establish general protocol or security coverage.
